question: Which problems exceed the total number of times they appear in the solution table when counting all occurrences, across steps 1, 2, and 3, where any non-"Stack" model's maximum test score is lower than the "Stack" model's test score for the same step and version?
sql:
-- Return just the problem names where occurrence count exceeds solution count
WITH stack_scores AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, test_score AS stack_test_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model = 'Stack'
),
non_stack_max AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, MAX(test_score) AS max_non_stack_test_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model != 'Stack'
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT s.name, s.version, s.step
    FROM stack_scores s
    JOIN non_stack_max n ON s.name = n.name AND s.version = n.version AND s.step = n.step
    WHERE n.max_non_stack_test_score < s.stack_test_score
),
qualifying_counts AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count
    FROM qualifying
    GROUP BY name
),
solution_counts AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS solution_count
    FROM solution
    GROUP BY name
)
SELECT q.name
FROM qualifying_counts q
JOIN solution_counts s ON q.name = s.name
WHERE q.occurrence_count > s.solution_count
ORDER BY q.name

-- Return just the problem names where occurrence count exceeds solution count
WITH stack_scores AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, test_score AS stack_test_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model = 'Stack'
),
non_stack_max AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, MAX(test_score) AS max_non_stack_test_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model != 'Stack'
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT s.name, s.version, s.step
    FROM stack_scores s
    JOIN non_stack_max n ON s.name = n.name AND s.version = n.version AND s.step = n.step
    WHERE n.max_non_stack_test_score < s.stack_test_score
),
qualifying_counts AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count
    FROM qualifying
    GROUP BY name
),
solution_counts AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS solution_count
    FROM solution
    GROUP BY name
)
SELECT q.name
FROM qualifying_counts q
JOIN solution_counts s ON q.name = s.name
WHERE q.occurrence_count > s.solution_count
ORDER BY q.name
